name: Custom report filter search narrows values, shows empty state, and restores on clear
description:
Objective: Custom report filter search narrows values, shows empty state, and restores on clear.
Preconditions: Open Reports comprehensive e2e with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reports comprehensive e2e.
2. Custom report filter search narrows values, shows empty state, and restores on clear.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Verify interactive search within Select Filters popover.
